blurb: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium is located on the shore at Cabrillo Beach in San Pedro, California. It offers free admission year-round with suggested donations. The aquarium provides educational programs, guided walks, and special events focused on marine science and coastal habitats.
extraNote: Suggested donation of $10 for adults and $5 for children and seniors · Reservations requested for groups of 15 or more for events · Credit/Debit Card payments only for parking
